commits.subject: Reconcile unfinished Cloud replies in the TUI transcript (#62403)
commits.reason: Adopt upstream's Cloud reply reconciliation and carry its item identity, unfinished position and copy order through the fork's retained transcript.
evidence: Replayed and paged Cloud replies are keyed by turn and item. An item with a start timestamp and no completion stays unfinished even if the turn page says completed. Empty unfinished items reserve a zero-height position. A final event replaces or removes those fragments in place and leaves unrelated streams running.

Copy order follows transcript position, including prepended pages. Turn completion without explicit text may use only a completed response from that turn. Upstream added controls for older pages, live Cloud resume and hidden directives.

The fork separately recovers an unseen final answer from a retired turn summary and checks its backend and thread. Its paged history and streaming correction hooks retain the original side-pane producer and viewed-image links. The native retained widget and cell codecs must preserve the new occurrence state and pending-cell identity across transfer. The prior codec stored only completed Cloud item IDs and a current-turn copy flag.
commits.revisit: Exercise upstream Cloud pagination, resume, copy/notification fallback, and the fork's retained-cell, legacy-reader and retired-summary controls on the integrated source.
